description: This Java source file defines the class MessageSendingFailedException, which represents an exception thrown when sending a message to an external system fails in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a builder class for constructing instances with additional properties.

classes.name: MessageSendingFailedException
classes.description: Immutable exception class representing failure to send a message, containing details such as error code, HTTP status, headers, message, description, cause, and a reference URI.
